summary.text: Wendell Jones is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 25, having assumed office on November 14, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as pastor.

paragraphs.text: Jones was born in Spartanburg, South Carolina, and lives in Piedmont, South Carolina; he graduated from Spartanburg High School in 1989 and earned a B.A. in finance from Wofford College in 1993.

His career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes owning a business and working as a pastor with Changing Your Mind Ministries, and he has served as president of the Wendell Jones Leadership Institute.
Jones succeeded Leola Robinson-Simpson in the seat and is assigned to the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
